text: From the run records, the per-seed N=128 to N=256 change in trained force R2 on data_seed 1 is +0.034 (seed 23) and -0.043 (seed 22), and it is -0.076/-0.062/-0.027 on data_seed 0 (seeds 24-26). Across these 5 seeds plus seeds 20-21 on data_seed 1 (about +0.01), is the trained-R2 change consistent with zero mean and a model-seed SD of about 0.04? If so, the only robust N=128 to N=256 effect is the control rise of +0.02 to +0.10.
